suichang-yinhou.about: Suichang Yinhou is a green tea named for Suichang county in Lishui, southwest Zhejiang. Little is documented about it, and the same silver monkey name is much better known from neighbouring Songyang.

yunxuan-9.doubt: No source names this cultivar: empty dossier, one web search found nothing, sources stay empty. Existence rests on the master list only; review or drop.
yunxuan-9.about: Yunxuan 9 is a name that appears for a Yunnan tea cultivar, and very little is documented about it. Its origin, its breeder and its traits are all unclear, so there is little to say with confidence.
